title: Spotlights: Discovering Improvement Opportunities in Software Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2609.20446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents and evolutionary code-search systems can improve implementations once a target and evaluation criterion have been specified. Applying these methods to an existing software repository raises an earlier question: which implementation choices are worth investigating for a high-level engineering objective? We introduce \emph{optimization-opportunity discovery}, the repository-level task of identifying candidate source regions, explaining how they relate to the objective, and proposing possible changes. The task takes as input a repository, an engineering objective, and optional runtime evidence such as offline telemetry observations or profiles. It does not require the user to specify a defect, bottleneck, or code location. We present \emph{Spotlights}, a system that performs this task through logical repository mapping, successive agent reviews, and optional research linking candidates to relevant techniques. translated_title: Spotlights：发现软件仓库中的改进机会
translated_abstract: 编码智能体和演化式代码搜索系统在指定目标与评估标准后可以改进代码实现。然而，将这些方法应用于现有软件仓库时会引出一个更早的问题：面对一个高层次的工程目标，哪些实现选择值得深入研究？我们提出了“优化机会发现”这一仓库级任务，即识别候选源代码区域、解释它们与目标之间的关联，并提出可能的修改方案。该任务以仓库、工程目标以及可选的运行时证据（如离线遥测观察或性能剖析数据）作为输入，无需用户预先指定缺陷、瓶颈或代码位置。我们提出了Spotlights系统，它通过逻辑仓库映射、多轮智能体审查，以及将候选点与相关技术联系起来的可选研究来执行该任务。我们对Spotlights的评估……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“优化机会发现”这一全新的仓库级任务，并设计了Spotlights系统，无需用户预先指定缺陷、瓶颈或代码位置，即可自动定位代码库中与工程目标相关的改进机会并提出可行的修改方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "optimization-opportunity discovery" as a new repository-level task and presents Spotlights, a system that automatically identifies which implementation choices in a codebase are worth investigating for a high-level engineering objective and proposes possible changes, without requiring users to specify defects, bottlenecks, or code locations.
